# NivoLeads

> NivoLeads is a verified commercial B2B lead generation platform and business contact directory providing direct 10-digit mobile phone numbers, company names, areas, addresses, and websites.

## Core Capabilities & Offerings
- **Verified Business Phone Numbers**: 100% normalized, cleaned, and verified 10-digit mobile numbers stripped of duplicates, dead entries, and spam.
- **Geographic & Industry Segmentation**: Filter leads by Country (India, USA), State/Region (e.g. Karnataka, New York, California), City/District (e.g. Bengaluru, Vijayapura, Belagavi, Mysuru), and 12 Industry Sectors.
- **Smart Zero-Duplicate Engine**: Automatic deduplication tracking ensuring repeat buyers never pay for the same phone number twice.
- **Instant Excel & CSV Export**: Immediate digital downloads in .xlsx and .csv format for sales prospecting, cold calling, and WhatsApp marketing campaigns.
- **Target Audience**: B2B sales teams, freelancers, web designers, digital marketing agencies, SEO consultants, and enterprise growth teams.

## Key Industry Sectors Covered
- Healthcare (Hospitals, Clinics & Diagnostic Labs)
- Education & Training (Colleges, Schools & Training Institutes)
- Real Estate & Construction (Builders, Developers & Contractors)
- Health, Fitness & Beauty (Gyms, Fitness Centers, Salons & Wellness)
- Food, Restaurants & Hotels (Restaurants, Cafes & Hospitality)
- Shopping & Retail (Supermarkets, Retail Stores & FMCG)
- IT & Digital Services (Software Companies & Tech Agencies)
- Professional Services (Legal, CA, Finance & Consulting)
- Automobile & Transport (Auto Dealers, Garages & Logistics)
- Industries & Manufacturing (Factories & Production Units)
- Travel & Tourism (Travel Agencies, Tour Operators & Resorts)
- Agriculture & Agro Businesses (Farms, Agro-tech & Equipment)

## Key Endpoints & Directory Links
- [Homepage](https://nivoleads.com): Overview, search filters, and pricing tiers.
- [Leads Directory](https://nivoleads.com/leads): Master directory index of all 31 Karnataka districts and 12 core industries.
- [District Directory Pages](https://nivoleads.com/leads/{district}): Deep-dive pages with sample listings for each district (e.g. `https://nivoleads.com/leads/vijayapura`, `https://nivoleads.com/leads/bengaluru-urban`).
- [Industry + Location Landing Pages](https://nivoleads.com/leads/{district}/{category}): Dedicated sector listings (e.g. `https://nivoleads.com/leads/vijayapura/healthcare`).
- [Explore Data & Lead Builder](https://nivoleads.com/explore): Search businesses by location, district, and sector.
- [Client Portal](https://nivoleads.com/login): Account sign in and dataset management.
- [Terms & Licensing](https://nivoleads.com/terms): Commercial data use and compliance terms.
- [Privacy Policy](https://nivoleads.com/privacy): Data protection standards and compliance.
- [Support Desk](https://nivoleads.com/contact): Customer service and custom enterprise dataset orders.
